prompt:
Pixel art character portrait for a gothic dark fantasy tactical RPG set in a sunless church city lit only by tallow lanterns, in the style of detailed 16-bit SNES/GBA-era RPG portraits. Square 1:1 image. Head and shoulders (for a creature: head and forequarters), the head filling about half the frame, three-quarter view facing slightly to the viewer's right, eyes looking right. Lighting: a warm amber tallow-lantern rim light from the right, soft warm fill light, deep warm brown shadows. Clear dark outlines, hand-placed pixel clusters, limited palette with 4 shades per colour, light dithering on metal and cloth. Muted, matte, grimy materials: dented iron, boiled leather, wool and soot-stained linen; anything corrupted is jet-black bone, chalk-white calcified growth and glowing violet marrow. Colours only from this palette and its shades: void black #0a0b10, damp basalt #14171f, wet slate #1e232d, rotting oak #2c221e, scavenged iron #4b5563, polished steel #9ca3af, bleached linen #d9cbb4, cinder ash #6b7280, boiled leather #92400e, tallow amber #d97706, candle gold #fbbf24, arterial red #e11d48, rust crimson #991b1b, blight violet #9333ea, resonant orchid #c084fc, salt cyan #06b6d4; human skin #6b4a3a / #a47a5f / #d4a988, pale and underfed. The subject reads clearly against the dark: mid-tone figure, bright accents only on small details. Plain flat very dark background (#120e12), no gradient, no scenery, nothing behind the figure. No border, no frame, no text, no logo, no watermark.
Stylized, not realistic: an expressive, larger-than-life character design with a bold, readable silhouette and pushed shapes (jaw, brow, cheekbones, nose, neck and build exaggerated to show who the character is), like a dark fantasy game's character art rather than a painted photograph. The character block says how far to push: warm and readable, in between, or far (gaunt, elongated, uncanny or grotesque).
Large, well-defined features that stay readable when pixelated to a small game portrait: big clearly drawn eyes with distinct whites, iris and dark lids, strong dark brows, a large defined mouth with clear lips, a slightly oversized head, and bold dark outlines around the eyes, brows, nose and mouth.
Hair exactly as the character block describes, with its own length and style; no hood, cowl, veil or tied-back hair unless the character block asks for it.

Character: Dunstan "Slag-Jaw", the Slag-Brute. Stylization warm and readable, pushed toward bulk: a big blocky head on a thick bull neck, a heavy jutting brow, deep-set fierce eyes with thick dark upper lids, bright irises and a catchlight each, a broad flattened nose, a wide, grim mouth. A young man of twenty-two, an adult, towering and massively built, with huge sloping shoulders and arms. A shaven scalp with dark stubble. The right half of his jaw, on the near side toward the viewer (the left of the picture), is a mass of glossy, ridged slag-burn scar from the chin to below the ear, the jawbone held together by twists of black scrap-iron wire and a riveted iron strap along the jawline, clearly readable at small size; the other half of his jaw is whole, with dark stubble. Bare, soot-smeared shoulders and arms, a raised brand scar on his near shoulder, the top of a heavy scorched leather foundry apron at the bottom of the frame. His huge fists are raised in front of his chest, the knuckles broad as coal shovels, both scarred wrists locked in thick riveted iron penal cuffs worn as knuckle guards, a few links of broken chain hanging from them.
Mood: defiant, smouldering, loyal.
Main colours: soot void black and cinder ash, scavenged iron cuffs and wire, burn-scar pink and rust crimson, warm tallow light on bare skin.
